evidence.MCL: Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Periligamentous edema, likely related to adjacent pathology.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Diffuse complex degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Small complex tear of the lateral meniscal body, characterized by a dominant horizontal component.
evidence.Medial OA: Large confluent regions of full-thickness articular cartilage loss at the weightbearing aspect of the joint.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Articular cartilage irregularity at the weightbearing aspect of the joint
evidence.PF OA: Focal full-thickness chondral defect at the lateral patellar facet measuring 6 x 6 mm.
evidence.Contusion: Confluent subchondral bone marrow edema at the medial femoral condyle.
evidence.Fracture: Acute subchondral insufficiency fracture at the weightbearing medial femoral condyle.
